description: This file defines the class 'tlvReceiverLinkMetric' which models a TLV (Type-Length-Value) structure for receiver link metrics in IEEE 1905.1 network management. It includes data structures, methods for serialization, and accessors related to link metrics between network interfaces.

classes.name: tlvReceiverLinkMetric
classes.description: Represents a TLV for receiver link metrics in IEEE 1905.1, providing methods for parsing, serialization, and access to link metric data.

methods.name: tlvReceiverLinkMetric
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a buffer for parsing.

methods.name: tlvReceiverLinkMetric
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object from a shared pointer to a BaseClass.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the TLV.

methods.name: reporter_al_mac
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the reporter.

methods.name: neighbor_al_mac
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the neighbor.

methods.name: interface_pair_info_length
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the interface pair info array.

methods.name: interface_pair_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific interface pair by index.

methods.name: alloc_interface_pair_info
methods.description: Allocates memory for a specified number of interface pair info entries.

methods.name: class_swap
methods.description: Performs byte order swapping for serialization.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the TLV structure before transmission.

methods.name: get_initial_size
methods.description: Returns the initial size of the TLV structure.
